purpose: Operational router after the 10–11 August upgrade sweep. The useful public-discovery phase is closed. Existing cases now supply enough distinct object/document mechanisms for synthesis and writing; remaining open edges are exact-source or item-level refinements.
principle: A next action must be capable of changing attribution, chronology, object identity, custody or historical mechanism. Geographic coverage, repeated web searching, collection-count growth and generic comparator accumulation are inactive.

resume_rule: Resume only when an exact requested source arrives, the user supplies a new object/image, or a newly bounded identifier appears. Otherwise do not search further; synthesize and write from the closed chains.
do_not_do: No broad maker-name or institution-name searching without a bounded bridge.
No promotion from collection-level S to item-level S by inference.
No silent equivalence between historical serial numbers, accession numbers, cabinet slots and modern database IDs.
